caption: Compare bases position by position: only positions 1 and 3 match, so their bits 0 and 1 form the sifted key 01. Positions 2 and 4 are discarded.

spec.title: BB84 sifting: worked example
spec.aria: A table of four BB84 positions shows Alice's bits 0,1,1,0, Alice's bases +,+,×,×, Bob's bases +,×,×,+, matches at positions 1 and 3, and the sifted key 01.
